bic_trace_step.reason: This commit introduces the vulnerable construct. It adds `free_rsp_buf(err_buftype, err_iov.iov_base);` to fix a memory leak when retrying `SMB2_open()` upon encountering `-EACCES`. However, it fails to reset `err_iov.iov_base` to `NULL` and `err_buftype` to `CIFS_NO_BUFFER` (or similar) before the second `SMB2_open()` call. If the second `SMB2_open()` call fails without overwriting these variables, the cleanup code at the end of `smb2_open_file()` will attempt to free them again, resulting in a double free.
